title: AI Compass
subtitle: 1 to 5-star digital and organizational maturity diagnostic evaluating data readiness, predictive analytics, and automated compliance.

sections.heading: 5-Tier Digital Maturity Diagnostic
sections.body: AI Compass™ benchmarks enterprise capabilities on a 1-to-5 star scale — moving organisations from fragmented, manual PDF workflows (1★) through structured API architectures (3★) to fully automated, predictive AI models (5★).

sections.heading: Data Infrastructure & Automated Compliance
sections.body: Before deploying AI algorithms, systems must be data-ready. AI Compass audits pipeline architecture, synthetic identity integrity, and automated governance to ensure models remain performant, audit-compliant, and secure.
